01 Input

02 Transformation

Applied rule

Duration per visual = DAX query + display + other steps. We sort from longest to shortest and identify the slowest component. The threshold marks which visuals to investigate. Summed visual durations are not page load time: executions may overlap.

→

03 Output

Initial sample reference

In the initial sample, V02 takes 2,500 ms: 1,900 ms for the DAX query, 400 ms for display and 200 ms for other steps. It is first in the investigation queue.

Take the task to your assistant

The timings are fictional. This calculation does not execute DAX, read a PBIX file or prove the cause of slowness. Compare repeated measurements with equivalent filters and cache conditions before and after any change.

Next steps in your environment

  1. Collect measurements per visual under comparable conditions.
  2. Prioritize the visual and component with the longest duration.
  3. Repeat measurements and check metrics after each change.

Prompt for your assistant

Review the performance of [Power BI report] using [authorized measurements per visual]. Separate DAX query, display and other durations; rank visuals and identify the dominant component. Record filters and cache conditions. For the longest durations, propose an investigation of the model, measures or visual design according to available evidence. Do not present summed visual durations as page load time. Claim improvement only after repeating measurements and confirming that numerical results have been preserved.
